HOW TO PLAY

Find your personal charm.

01

Choose two intentions.Choose Love, Career, Wealth, Wellbeing, Connection or Growth. Ordinary draws give all six categories an equal chance.

02

Pick a face-down card.Every position uses the same odds. Your charm is saved before its reveal begins. Duplicates add to your existing count.

03

Your ten-draw promise.Each set of ten includes a match to either intention. If the first nine miss, the tenth chooses equally between your two intentions. An earlier match fulfils the promise. Intentions stay fixed until the set is complete.

04

Rarity is independent.Each category has C, R, S, SR and SSR charms. Matching your intention does not guarantee a higher rank.
